summary: Export RPM secrets into `secrets.yml`: `controller_secret_key` from `/etc/tower/SECRET_KEY`, `hub_secret_key` from `SECRET_KEY` in `/etc/pulp/settings.py`, `hub_db_fields_encryption_key` from `/etc/pulp/certs/database_fields.symmetric.key` and `gateway_secret_key` from `/etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/SECRET_KEY`. Copy custom files from `/etc/tower/conf.d` (not `postgres.py`, `channels.py`, `caching.py`, `cluster_host_id.py`) to `controller/custom_configs`.
questions: Where do I get the secret keys for AAP migration?
How do I export the hub symmetric key?

answer_card.title: Collect RPM secrets
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cat /etc/tower/SECRET_KEY                                       # controller_secret_key
grep '^SECRET_KEY' /etc/pulp/settings.py | awk -F'=' '{ print $2 }'  # hub_secret_key
cat /etc/pulp/certs/database_fields.symmetric.key               # hub_db_fields_encryption_key
cat /etc/ansible-automation-platform/gateway/SECRET_KEY         # gateway_secret_key
```
Copy custom `/etc/tower/conf.d/*.py` (not postgres, channels, caching, cluster_host_id) to `controller/custom_configs/`.
